items.text: Record Story 2.12's three live runs in docs/maintainer/evidence/epic-2.md: the claims race suite with the 30-minute case, bun-install.test.ts and the agent-contract live smoke, each with counts and duration, plus date, host, commit and bun version (A1)

Bind a retro's result to the commit it was validated at: re-run checkRetroDiff (or fail) when an adopted retro PR's head moved, and have reconcile write retro_result only when the merged head is the validated head; add moved-head tests (C1, A2)

Stop reconcile's queue handling losing approvals and attempts: re-enqueue a record left merging by the runner's own failure on its standing approval; do not re-park ungated retro and retro-item PRs awaiting-approval after an ejection; give a retro-item conflict a conflict session; close the open PR when the record beat fails after openPr (C2, C3, C6)

Make claims recover from outages: recognise a lost-ack swap followed by another lane's write as this lane's own claim, and retry recording a failed attempt before the trailing wait instead of holding the claim about 45 minutes (C4)

Decide what coordinator sessions may change inside the status files (e.g. a retro only appends action_items and sets its retro key; status planning never sets a Story done) and whether the coordinator write check stops folding its own allow-list (C5)

Run the follow-up reviews Stories 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 2.8, 2.9 and 2.11 recommended, on their named unverified risks, before tagging runner-8, and decide how the loop runs a follow-up review a spec asks for (E1)

Run bmad-correct-course for Epic 2's drift: reconcile spine, SPEC and glossary with the accepted deviations (A7, A8) and route the deferrals with no receiving Story: committed-content credential scan, reconcile branch cleanup, 2.7 attempts cap and inbox findings, 2.8 approved_graph timing and gate scope, AR10 cross-owner close (A3-A5, A9)

Fix wasted and risky session work: tell build sessions the runner owns epic-<N>-context.md and reverts it so they skip the recompile, make a status planning unit due when the Epic context is older than epics.md, and state that a denial is reported in denied_actions, never retried another way (E2, E3)

Set epic-2 to done in sprint-status.yaml and decide who writes an Epic's done key; decide whether the bot Co-authored-by trailer GitHub's squash adds is acceptable or change the squash settings (E6, E7)

Consolidate the coordinator steps before Epic 3: move describeError, parkBlocked, the CI poll, freshMain, closeOrphans, aborted and message(e) into the shared session module, build the lane run step wiring once, move checkModel behind the agent port, and extend the cycle test to src/core and break the core/next cycle (D1-D3)

Close Epic 2's verification gaps with tests: the retro step's lost-unit fence, the lane run coordinator-step wiring, 2.6's missing Standing Authority, only reconcile deletes ledger records, 2.5a fold rows for live-evidence and the coordinator retro classes, and 2.10's retro-item enqueue (C9)
